rows.ethical_framing: # gunnchos-hardware-industrial-design Industrial and electrical design source of truth for the **gunnchOS3k** first-party device family (Student 14.5, Handheld Hybrid, DS-XL Coder, Edge I/O Rings, First-party Dock). > **Current release/state:** `PHYSICAL_PENDING` — design/BOM/RFQ *packets* exist; no fab, no certification, no RFQ send from Cursor. > **Hardware v1.0 mainline (this campaign):** see [`hardware_v1/`](hard
CAD, BOM, device-class specs, firmware/OS compatibility handoff packages, and manufacturer-facing design artifacts for first-party hardware.
So OS, Lab, manufacturing, and education work share one honest hardware truth before physical EVT.
Product Charter **layer 1**. Consumed by `gunnchos-device-os`. Linked from the Ecosystem Portal.

- Device-family design packages and BOM/validation scripts (`make validate`, `make e2e` smoke) - OS/firmware compatibility export packages for Device Lab / OS - RFQ *packet* preparation artifacts (packets ≠ sent RFQs)
- QEMU/host firmware dry-runs and capsule *simulation* - Conceptual/legacy EVT-0 CAD framing (see `docs/history/`)
